r1_blocker_resolution.assessment: The diagnostic hashes executor bytes before CPU loading their net.token_cost buffer and checks its five-element finite shape. It prepends STOP gain zero to the saved chosen-modality gains and subtracts cost_weight * token_cost with torch arithmetic. The current producer's gain tensors and model token-cost buffer are float32. This removes the rounded .501 NumPy cost and its different near-threshold result. The output records the loaded token costs and bound executor hash.
dependency_evidence: dual_rgbt/model.py:182-189 selects the action with gains - cost_weight * token_cost.
dual_rgbt/e0_policy_refresh.py:69-73 returns the executor state unchanged for round1; lines122-145 load saved net state strictly into the model.

independent_regression.method: Executed the exact R2 main function with an in-memory serialized CPU checkpoint and four synthetic completed caches in each branch. The buffer uses the model-defined float32 costs; the gain is the original demonstrated R1 threshold case.
independent_regression.additional_evidence: A serialized alternate finite buffer [0,.6,.7,.8,1] was emitted and used by the source, proving that cost values come from the loaded buffer rather than a hidden hardcoded approximation. A broader 320-record test per branch covered both modalities and all five actual actions against a separate FP32 reference calculation.

r1_blocker_resolution.evidence_limit: The actual remote executor files were not loaded during this review. Source binding and numerical behavior were independently exercised with serialized synthetic checkpoint bytes; loading and hash-checking the actual buffer occurs in the admitted diagnostic.

engineering_assessment.check: Read-only CPU stdin delivery and stdout output

Reads manifest, executor, plans, progress, native status and caches; torch loads are explicitly map_location=cpu from the same in-memory bytes that are hashed. There is no write, subprocess, SSH invocation, model construction, forward, backward, optimizer or CUDA initialization in this tool. torch.cuda.is_initialized is a state check. Synthetic execution left CUDA uninitialized.

engineering_assessment.check: Completed-prefix publication, native binding and cache provenance

engineering_assessment.check: TRAIN labels, record shapes and numerical interpretation
engineering_assessment.evidence: The collector makes the causal tracking decision before reading that frame's TRAIN annotation and computing its offline quality/gain labels. The diagnostic reads train entries only. Current producer tensors are quality[1,2] and gain[1,2,4], with target/prediction xywh[4]; a real archived local DropMoE smoke cache confirmed these shapes and float32 dtypes. Reshapes, action/modality indices, finite-label checks, crop-centre test, quality sum/(2N), gain sum/(8N), and full-image xywh IoU agree with this schema.
engineering_assessment.interpretation: Statistics are record-weighted over valid stride-sampled TRAIN labels. They exclude initialization and unsaved intervening frames. Regret is conditioned on the actual chosen modality and saved candidates; it is not a fresh-policy rollout or an oracle over modalities. Localization utility inherits crop-clamped labels. The code does not read future-frame or TEST GT for these diagnostic computations.
